stickers.name: My boss
stickers.description: Nigerian comic-respect greeting. A small boy bows until his head touches the ground, caption 'My boss'. Use it to hail someone with playful respect: elders, customers, mentors, friends, or the user themselves — the way Nigerians say oga, chief, chairman, or my boss. It is a greeting and a show of respect, not a literal workplace boss sticker.
